g.text: Workload and scheduling checks across the complete sweep

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596779

g.text: Active output interval: 8–104; one event per 4,800 background token advances. Across five repeats, event counts round to 0.2 increments.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #596779

g.text: Token ratio is a workload descriptor, not a FLOP equivalence. Schedule-step counts can exceed 127 when some batches are partial.
